name: @ecom/backend
description: E-commerce platform backend: auth, admin and public NestJS services

scripts.build: npm run build:platform && npm run build -w @ecom/auth-service && npm run build -w @ecom/admin-service && npm run build -w @ecom/public-service
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w @ecom/auth-service && npm run seed -w @ecom/admin-service && npm run seed -w @ecom/public-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:platform && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.setup: npm run keys:generate && npm run kong:render
scripts.compose:validate: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml config --quiet
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate -w @ecom/auth-service && npm run migrate -w @ecom/admin-service && npm run migrate -w @ecom/public-service
scripts.migrate:status: npm run migrate:status -w @ecom/auth-service && npm run migrate:status -w @ecom/admin-service && npm run migrate:status -w @ecom/public-service
